market.question: Will London have between 25-30mm of precipitation in May?

assessment.reasoning: London May average precipitation is ~60mm. The 25-30mm bucket is well below mean (~1.2-1.5 std dev away). Probability of landing in any given 5mm bucket below mean is small; historical base rate ~7-10%.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Mid-month dry pattern could pull the total into the lower buckets
